Skytruth Analysis
A FIRE OCCURRED IN THE NITROCELLULOSE, AND RESIN STORAGE PAD AND SHED ON MAY 28, 2011. ALL RAW MATERIALS IN THE AREA WERE CONSUMED BY FIRE, AS WERE THE BUILDING STRUCTURES THEMSELVES. AT 1501 ON MAY 28, 2011 AN EMPLOYEE CALLED 911 TO REPORT A FIRE AT THE FACILITY. AS IT WAS A HOLIDAY WEEKEND THE FACILITY WAS EMPTY OF EMPLOYEES AT THE TIME. FIRST RESPONDERS WERE ON SITE AT 1507, NOTING THAT A FIRE WAS IN PROGRESS IN THE RESIN/SOLVENT STORAGE SHED ON THE EAST SIDE OF THE MANUFACTURING AREA (NEAR THE DUMPSTER). THE FIRE PROGRESSED TO THE RESIN STORAGE BUILDING AND FINALLY TO THE NITROCELLULOSE PAD. ADJACENT WAREHOUSES WERE ALSO BURNED. THE FIRE WAS DECLARED EXTINGUISHED AT 1801.

properties.content:

Medium Affected:

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 36.950161, -84.097536 (Approximated from CITY_STATE)
Reported Spill Volume: 1000 gallon
Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** ON 09/12/13 AT 1639 HOURS, CONTRACTOR WITH STEVA LOGISTICS, REPORTED TRAIN CREW INFORMED HIM OF A FUEL LEAK AT THE REFUELING STATION IN CORBIN YARD, CORBIN, KENTUCKY. THIS WAS LOCATED AT MILEPOST C 172 ON THE KD SUB. CALLER STATED HE WENT TO THE STATION AND FOUND DIESEL FUEL COMING FROM THE PUMP INTO THE CONCRETE DIKE. CALLER STATED HE TURNED OFF THE PUMP VALVES AND SHUT OFF THE LEAK. HE SPOKE WITH ENVIRONMENTAL SERVICES WHO TOLD HIM TO CALL THE PSCC TO REPORT IT. HOWEVER, SHE WAS EN ROUTE AND AN INDIVIDUAL STATED HE DID NOT KNOW WHEN OR HOW LONG THE PUMP WAS RUNNING. IN ADDITION, HE DOES NOT HAVE AN ESTIMATE OF HOW MUCH FUEL WENT INTO THE CONTAINMENT DIKE. HE IS CLEANING UP HIS VEHICLE WHERE LIGHT AMOUNT OF FUEL SPRAYED ONTO IT. HOWEVER, NOTHING IS REPORTED ON THE GROUND. HE IS AWAITING AN INDIVIDUAL WHO IS EN ROUTE TO PROVIDED ADDITIONAL INFO. THERE WERE NO CSX EMPLOYEES AROUND FOR ME TO SPEAK TO. UPDATE: AT 1740 HOURS, CCM CALLED AND ADVISED INDIVIDUAL CONTACTED HIM AND STATED APPROXIMATELY 1000 GALLONS OF FUEL SPILLED FROM THE PADDING ON THE CONCRETE INTO THE STORM WATER TREATMENT SYSTEM WHICH GOES TO A CREEK; HOWEVER, THERE WAS NOTHING REPORTED IN THE WATERWAYS. INDIVIDUAL CONFIRMED THAT THERE WERE NO SPILLS ON THE GROUND AND REQUESTED NRC BE NOTIFIED.
